translations.src: Take 1 tablet twice daily after meals.
translations.out: Chukua kidonge kimoja mara mbili kila siku baada ya chakula.

translations.src: Paracetamol 500 mg tablets. Take 2 tablets every 8 hours.
translations.out: Paracetamol 500 mg vidonge. Chukua vidonge 2 kila saa 8.

translations.src: Dose: 1x3 for 5 days.
translations.out: Kipimo: 1x3 kwa siku 5.

translations.src: Amoxicillin 250 mg/5 ml oral suspension. Give 5 ml three times a day.
translations.out: Amoxicillin 250 mg/5 ml suspension ya mdomo. Toa 5 ml mara tatu kwa siku.

translations.src: Do not take more than 8 tablets in 24 hours.
translations.out: Usitumie zaidi ya vidonge 8 kwa saa 24.

translations.src: 30 tablets.
translations.out: Vidonge 30.

translations.src: Take 1 capsule once daily in the morning.
translations.out: Chukua kidonge kimoja mara moja kila siku asubuhi.

translations.src: Metformin 850 mg. Take 1 tablet twice a day with food.
translations.out: Metformin 850 mg. Chukua vidonge 1 mara mbili kwa siku pamoja na chakula.

translations.src: Amlodipine 5 mg. 1 tablet at night.
translations.out: Amlodipine 5 mg. 1 vidonge usiku.

translations.src: Shake well before use. Take 10 ml every 6 hours.
translations.out: Tetepeta vizuri kabla ya kutumia. Chukua 10 ml kila baada ya saa 6.

translations.src: Store below 25°C. Keep out of reach of children.
translations.out: Hifadhi chini ya 25°C. Weka nje ya kupatikana kwa watoto.

translations.src: Take 2 tablets on day 1, then 1 tablet daily for 4 days.
translations.out: Chukua vidonge 2 siku ya 1, kisha vidonge 1 kila siku kwa siku 4.

translations.src: Ibuprofen 400 mg. Take 1 tablet every 8 hours with food. Maximum 3 tablets a day.
translations.out: Ibuprofen 400 mg. Chukua vidonge 1 kila baada ya saa 8 pamoja na chakula. Kiasi cha juu cha vidonge 3 kwa siku.

translations.src: Use within 14 days of opening.
translations.out: Tumia ndani ya siku 14 baada ya kufunguliwa.

translations.src: Apply a thin layer 2 times a day for 7 days.
translations.out: Tumia safu nyembamba mara 2 kwa siku kwa siku 7.

translations.src: Insulin 100 IU/ml. Inject 12 units before breakfast.
translations.out: Insulin 100 IU/ml. Ingiza uniti 12 kabla ya kiamsha kinywa.

translations.src: Children 6 to 12 years: half a tablet (250 mg) every 6 hours.
translations.out: Watoto wenye umri wa miaka 6 hadi 12: nusu kibao (250 mg) kila saa 6.

translations.src: Expiry: 03/2028. Batch: B2417.
translations.out: Muda wa kumalizika: 03/2028. Kundi: B2417.

translations.src: Take 1 tablet every 12 hours. Complete the full course of 14 tablets.
translations.out: Chukua kidonge kimoja kila baada ya saa 12. Kamilisha kozi nzima ya vidonge 14.

translations.src: Hydrochlorothiazide 12.5 mg. Take 1 tablet in the morning.
translations.out: Hydrochlorothiazide 12.5 mg. Chukua vidonge 1 asubuhi.
